title: Kenya’s ride-hailing drivers abandon apps as fuel strike cripples Nairobi
interpretation: This matter strategically as it could impact ride-hailing services' operational efficiency, customer experience, and ultimately their valuation.

risk: Investments in ride-hailing companies are exposed to operational risks such as fuel strikes, which can significantly impact their financial performance.

title: Africa has seen oil shocks before. Why 2026 could be the turning point for clean energy
interpretation: The shift towards clean energy in Africa could have significant strategic implications for the region's economic diversification and environmental sustainability.
opportunity: Investors who position themselves in the African clean energy sector may benefit from growing demand for renewable energy solutions.
risk: The transition to clean energy could lead to disruptions in the oil and gas industry, posing financial risks for companies invested in these sectors.

title: The Kenyan Boeing engineer who chose trucks over prestige

title: Samsung phones that lost software support in May 2026
